messages:
Sam (AE): flagging an exec escalation — HelioMetrics POC is blocked on three fronts: (1) customer insists on BYOK KMS integration for the POC, (2) they want a hard price cap for a 4-week dedicated evaluation, and (3) their security team raised a question on our data retention policy in the security questionnaire. They want answers before any dedicated pool is provisioned.

Priya (AE Lead): thanks Sam. We should avoid tooling work for BYOK in the POC if possible. Can we offer a temporary kept-keys flow (HSM token exchange) and an architecture diagram? Marco / Lina, is there a quick path?

Marco (Sales Eng): tech note: full BYOK (customer-managed KMS in their account) requires platform changes and an IAM token exchange — not doable for a short POC. We can offer envelope encryption where Helio uploads a wrapping key and we use it to encrypt model cache blobs; no root key access. Quick to enable (config toggle + restart).

Lina (SecEng): confirm Marco. Envelope-wrapping with a customer-supplied key (rotate-able) meets most BYOK asks for proof-of-data control, but customer will still ask for attestations. I'll prepare a short control statement and a minimal diagram. ETA 3h.

Nate (Finance): pricing side: they want a firm cap for 4 weeks on a dedicated 4-GPU pool. Do we have precedent for fixed POC caps? We can do a capped SOW credit structure: invoice cap X, overage liability to customer after threshold. Need concrete numbers — what credit amount do you want to propose?

Sam (AE): customer proposed $25k cap. We need to make a commercial call. Priya / Nate, can we propose $20k credit + an extra 1-week burst if they sign reserved capacity within 30 days?

Priya (AE Lead): sounds reasonable if legal ok. Add clause: credit non-transferable, applied to first invoice on conversion. Also require minimal usage telemetry sharing for cost/benchmarking.

legal-bot: draft SOW amendment template created: https://redwood.app/legal/drafts/helio-poc-amend-v1. Includes credit clause and limited POC terms. Legal notes: no DPA change required for envelope key test, but production BYOK needs DPA + network terms.

Marco (Sales Eng): sample SOW snippet to include: ```
POC_CREDIT: $20,000
DURATION: 4 weeks + 1 optional burst week
TERMS: credit applied to first invoice if customer signs Reserved Capacity within 30 days
```

Lina (SecEng): security questionnaire — Helio asked about retention windows and ephemeral cache. Our answer: inference cache TTL 24h by default, model artifacts persist per tenant only with encryption-at-rest. I'll attach the short controls matrix (SOC2 mapping) once updated.

Sam (AE): customer says retention TTL must be <= 24h and wants audit logs forwarded to their SIEM for the POC. Is log forwarding doable?

Marco (Sales Eng): we can ship logs to a customer-owned S3 (signed URL) or to their Splunk/Datadog endpoint via forwarder. For short-term POC, S3 drop with lifecycle policy is quickest.

Nate (Finance): commercial ask: if we go $20k credit we should include a short ROI statement for execs. Also mark the account as strategic for potential discount floors.

Priya (AE Lead): scheduling exec bridge only if legal or finance can't clear today. Ops: are there infra blockers for envelope key or log forwarding?

ops-bot: ticket infra-7731 created for "envelope-key toggle + s3-log-drop". ETA 6h. Please assign owner.

Lina (SecEng): I'll assemble the controls matrix: network segregation, KMS envelope, audit log forwarding, SIEM integration, retention policies. ETA 3h and will send to Sam to forward to Helio CISO.

Sam (AE): customer asks for a firm commitment: if we can't enable envelope-KMS + logs within 48h they will pause POC. We have 48h window. Priya, high priority.

Priya (AE Lead): understood. Plan: (A) legal signoff on SOW credit today, (B) enable envelope-key toggle (ops) within 6h, (C) Lina ship controls matrix within 3h. If all three move forward, no exec bridge. If any miss, open exec bridge at EOD.

Nate (Finance): I'll greenlight the $20k credit conditional on SOW and telemetry clause. Marking finance owner as Nate.

legal-bot: SOW template moved to review queue; legal reviewer: @Olivia. Please approve by EOD for timely dispatch.

Marco (Sales Eng): documenting temporary runbook for POC: 1) enable envelope-key toggle, 2) configure S3 log drop with lifecycle 7d, 3) provision dedicated 4-GPU pool with usage cap. Revert plan: remove alias and purge ephemeral cache after POC.

Sam (AE): sent update to Helio CISO: we propose envelope-KMS + S3 log drops and $20k credit. Awaiting their ack.

Lina (SecEng): uploaded preliminary controls document: https://redwood.app/drive/helio-controls/poc-v1 and sent to customer.

Priya (AE Lead): monitoring. If ops infra ETA slips beyond 48h we escalate to execs. Thanks team. :eyes:

Sam (AE): will post final status after Olivia (legal) approves SOW.
